== drop-table
0 drop-table destructive posts: drops table posts and its rows
== rename-table
0 rename-table review accounts: renames table users to accounts; code that uses the old name breaks while old and new versions run together
== add-column-optional
0 zero-default review users.nickname [cases_test.go]: adds column users.nickname as NOT NULL with default ''; existing rows get '': give the field a Default or make it Nillable if that is not their value

== add-column-required
0 add-required-column destructive users.joined_at [cases_test.go]: adds column users.joined_at as NOT NULL with no default; it fails if the table has rows: give the field a Default or make it Nillable, or allow it only on an empty table
